name: St. Joseph County Board of Health
what_it_decides: Sets policy for the county health department and appoints the county health officer.
appointing_authorities: 7 seats appointed by the County Board of Commissioners; South Bend mayor (1 seat); Mishawaka mayor (1 seat)
notes: 2026 roster: all 7 filled seats appointed by the Commissioners; the two mayor seats listed vacant. Commissioner appointments were criticized in 2022-23 WVPE reports. Taxing power not stated in sources.

name: St. Joseph County Redevelopment Commission
seats: 5 voting + 1 nonvoting adviser (adviser seat vacant as of 2026-11-10)
appointing_authorities: Board of Commissioners (3 voting members and the nonvoting adviser); County Council (2 voting members) (IC 36-7-14-6.1(b))
notes: One-year terms (county page: all are appointed to 1 year terms). Meets the 2nd Tuesday at 9:00 a.m., 4th-floor Council Chambers, County-City Building. The St. Joseph County Redevelopment Authority is a different body; it has posted no agendas since February 2024.

name: Area Plan Commission of St. Joseph County
what_it_decides: Planning, rezoning and subdivision control for the unincorporated county and the towns of Lakeville, New Carlisle, North Liberty, Osceola and Roseland. Not South Bend or Mishawaka. Variances and special uses go to the separate Area Board of Zoning Appeals.
appointing_authorities: County Commissioners (2: an agricultural-interests and a citizen member); County Council (1 citizen member); County Surveyor (seat set by state law); North Liberty, New Carlisle and Osceola town councils (1 each); Lakeville and Roseland jointly through the Advisory Council on Town Affairs (1); school corporation superintendents (1)
notes: Nine members representing six member units (the county and five towns), under IC 36-7-4-202. The earlier description "county-wide zoning; approves redevelopment plans" was wrong: South Bend and Mishawaka are not members. A 2019 annual report still listed a South Bend mayoral appointee.

name: St. Joseph County Airport Authority
appointing_authorities: County Board of Commissioners (all four members; bipartisan)
notes: Taxing power not stated. A commissioner-appointed member (Kostielney) was named in 2022.

name: St. Joseph County Public Library Board of Trustees
appointing_authorities: St. Joseph County Commissioners (2); County Council (2); South Bend Community School Corporation board (2); presidents of the John Glenn and Union North (LaVille) school boards jointly (1)
notes: Trustees serve four-year terms, up to four consecutive. A 2024-25 dispute over seating a nominee was reported. Library districts levy property tax in Indiana (not verified in sources). Appointing split read from the library board page 2026-11-08; normally meets the 4th Monday at 4:15 pm.

name: Mishawaka-Penn-Harris Public Library Board of Trustees
appointing_authorities: School City of Mishawaka board (2); County Council (2); County Commissioners (2); Penn-Harris-Madison school board (1)
notes: Taxing power not stated on the board page. Meeting day conflict: the library page reads "third Thursday ... at 4 p.m." (gap-fill B; the page timed out on re-check 2026-11-08) while the city's 2025 appointing-authority disclosure says 2nd Thursday at 4. Both recorded; not resolved.

name: Transpo (South Bend Public Transportation Corporation) board
appointing_authorities: Mayor of South Bend (3); South Bend Common Council (4); Mayor of Mishawaka (1); Mishawaka Common Council (1)
notes: Typically meets the third Monday of the month at 4:00 p.m. at the Transpo administration and operations facility (some 2026 meetings on other days). Levy not found.

name: South Bend Redevelopment Commission
what_it_decides: Redevelopment and tax-increment decisions for the city.
appointing_authorities: Mayor (3 voting members); Common Council (2 voting members); the Mayor also appoints a non-voting adviser, who must be a school board member or a person the school board recommends (IC 36-7-14-6.1(a), (d)); currently an SBCSC trustee.
notes: Appointers checked 2026-11-18 on the city page (last updated Oct 1, 2026) and in IC 36-7-14-6.1. Gap-fill B lead, not re-read: regular meetings on the second and fourth Thursdays at 9:30 a.m.

name: South Bend Board of Public Works
what_it_decides: The city's contracting agency for most city business: construction bids and quotations, purchases, contracts, leases, easements and encroachments, use and vacation of public rights-of-way, and hearings on transient-merchant, scrap-metal and massage-establishment licences (city page).
seats: 3 or 5 by law (IC 36-4-9-6(d)); five seated in 2026
appointing_authorities: Mayor of South Bend (indefinite terms, per the city page; IC 36-4-9-6(d))
notes: Separate from the South Bend Board of Public Safety (IC 36-4-9-5(b); city boards index). The clerk is not a member.

name: South Bend Board of Public Safety
what_it_decides: General policies and procedures of the police and fire departments (IC 36-8-3-2): approves duty-manual policy changes and collective bargaining agreements, receives department reports, oversees department property. Since 2025, hiring, promotion, demotion and discipline sit with the Fire Merit Commission and Police Merit Board (city page).
seats: 3 or 5 by law (IC 36-4-9-6(d)); the city page says five but lists three members (as of 2026-07-02)
appointing_authorities: Mayor of South Bend (indefinite terms, per the city page; IC 36-4-9-6(d))
notes: Meets the 3rd Wednesday at 9:15 a.m. or as needed (city page).

name: Housing Authority of South Bend Board of Commissioners
what_it_decides: Governs the housing authority (public housing and vouchers under federal rules).
appointing_authorities: Mayor of South Bend
notes: Seven per the audit report reviewed by the State Board of Accounts (2024). CONFLICT: 2023 news reports (95.3 MNC, ABC57) said all six commissioners had been appointed by the mayor. A 2023 council bill to split appointments was reported tabled. Both counts recorded; the audit is the more recent primary source.

name: Mishawaka Board of Public Works and Safety (and Utility Board)
what_it_decides: City public works and safety administration; utility oversight.
appointing_authorities: Mayor (per the city 2025 appointing-authority disclosure)
notes: Meets Tuesdays at 10:00 am; one-year terms. The Utility Board has the same president and vice president (Ken Prince, Rebecca Maguire); its third member is Anthony Violi, while this board's is George Obren (city page, read 2026-11-18).

name: Mishawaka Plan Commission
appointing_authorities: Mayor (5 citizen members); Common Council (1, from its members); Parks and Recreation Board (1); Board of Public Works and Safety (1); City civil engineer or a qualified assistant the engineer appoints (ex officio, IC 36-7-4-207(a)(4)); the city page lists Chris Jamrose, City Engineer, without a Member label.
notes: Seat count and tagged appointers from the city 2025 appointing-authority disclosure. The city commission page (read 2026-11-18) lists the Parks and Recreation Board appointee. The Common Council appointee for 2026 is Matt Carroll.

name: Mishawaka Redevelopment Commission
appointing_authorities: Mayor (3 voting members); Common Council (2 voting members); Mayor appoints the non-voting adviser
notes: Seats and appointers from the city's commission page (read 2026-11-18): five voting members, each appointed to a one-year term, Mayor 3 and Common Council 2, plus a non-voting adviser (IC 36-7-14-6.1(a)).

name: Mishawaka Board of Zoning Appeals
appointing_authorities: Mayor (3); Common Council (1); Plan Commission (1)
notes: Four-year terms; meets the 2nd Tuesday of the month at 6:00 pm when there is business (city 2025 appointing-authority disclosure).

name: Mishawaka Parks and Recreation board
appointing_authorities: Mayor (4); Library Board (1); School Board (1)
notes: Seat count and the library and school board seats from the city 2025 appointing-authority disclosure; the mayor count is the remainder.

name: Mishawaka Historic Preservation Commission
appointing_authorities: Mayor (nine members listed, one titled Common Council Representative); the page has a Common Council Appointment heading with no name; advisory members: appointer not stated
notes: Appointers as printed on the city's commission page (read 2026-11-18). Seat count: nine voting members listed under Mayoral Appointments, an empty Common Council Appointment heading, and five advisory members; the page states no seat count.

name: Mishawaka Traffic Commission
seats: 5 members listed (2 ex officio, 3 appointed) plus 2 non-member advisors by virtue of position; page states no seat count
appointing_authorities: Ex officio (City Engineer, Police Chief); Mayor (2); City Council (1)
notes: Appointers as printed on the city's commission page (read 2026-11-18).

name: Mishawaka Housing Authority Board of Commissioners
appointing_authorities: Mayor of Mishawaka (all seven)
notes: Four-year terms (city 2025 appointing-authority disclosure).

name: School City of Mishawaka appointed trustees (2 of 5 seats)
what_it_decides: Two seats on the five-member school board.
appointing_authorities: Mishawaka Common Council (1); Mayor of Mishawaka (1)
notes: Reported by Wikipedia/local report in research.
